sheets.subtitle: ICY S'26 · registration analysis

items.definition: ICY_S26_Registrations.xlsx (424 form submissions).
One registrant per person (same e-mail / phone); the earliest submission is kept. 0 duplicates removed.
Rows that are obviously test or fake entries are excluded before any count.
23 May – 6 Jun (15 calendar days), dates in the form's local time.
The tracked source of the registration (UTM source / medium / content). Registrations without a tag are 'Direct / Other'.
Channels are grouped into Telegram, Instagram, Email, Offline, Partners and Direct / Other for the group-level tables.
Registrations of a channel or segment divided by all unique registrants.
Herfindahl index = sum of squared shares. 1 means everything came from one source; effective # = 1 / HHI.
Daily registrations minus the daily mean, divided by the standard deviation; z ≥ 1.5 is flagged as a spike.
Early = Bachelor Y1–Y2; Senior = Bachelor Y3–Y4; Grad / Postgrad = Graduate, Masters, PhD; everything else = Pre-uni / Other.
Percent columns use only registrants who answered that question; empty answers are not counted as 'No'.
